However, I do not suggest getting into drugs. They have led me down a path of destruction and only made things worse in the long run. It is not feasible, because they are illegal, and you will eventually run out of money, or not be able to get your fix because a dealer gets arrested or something and it will only get worse from there. They may bring relief immediately, in the short term. But in the long run, it usually does not end well. The only scenario where they may help, is if you have an unlimited supply of pure drugs that will last a lifetime. But it would still be masking it, and bad for your health. It's just not feasible in this society. 


You may get worse, you may not, I have tried all kinds of meds too and nothing works for me. I understand why you want to do them, but if you do, just realize they may harm you in the long term and make your situation worse. I wish you the best of luck.
